query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('default_acls',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'schema',n.nspname,'type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text)) FROM pg_default_acl d JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=d.defaclrole LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace WHERE r.rolname='postgres' AND (n.nspname IN ('public','private') OR d.defaclnamespace=0)),'public_schema_acl',(SELECT nspacl::text FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public'),'private_schema_acl',(SELECT nspacl::text FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='private')) AS grants;
